# Reproducibility

Practical notes for running the lab and reading the artifacts. Narrative is lighter here on purpose.

## How to run

```bash
cd mnist-generative-models-lab
python -m venv venv
# Windows: venv\Scripts\activate
# macOS/Linux: source venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
jupyter notebook notebooks/
```

Tested on **Python 3.13.5**. Package versions are pinned in [`requirements.txt`](https://github.com/jt-09/mnist-generative-models-lab/blob/main/requirements.txt).

::: {.callout-warning}
## Working directory

Run notebooks with the **repository root** as the working directory so paths like `./training_results/` and `./latent_data/` resolve correctly.
:::

## Artifact policy

Training outputs are **gitignored** and regenerated locally:

| Path | Created by | Contents |
|------|------------|----------|
| `training_results/` | `vae.ipynb`, `latent_diffusion_mlp.ipynb` | `vae_model.pth`, plots, pickles |
| `latent_data/` | `latent_diffusion_mlp.ipynb` | latent `.npy` arrays, labels |
| `ddpm_mnist*.pth` | `ddpm.ipynb` | DDPM checkpoints |

Metrics on this site come from **saved notebook runs**. Full retraining is optional. Do not commit checkpoints or large arrays.

## Canonical metrics

### Classification

| Model | Test accuracy |
|-------|---------------|
| KNN (GPU, k=3) | 0.9705 |
| Logistic regression | 0.9241 |
| Manual MLP | 0.9794 |
| SimpleCNN | 0.9871 |
| Comparison CNN | 0.9913 |

### Generative

| Model | Metric | Value |
|-------|--------|-------|
| VAE (16-D) | Train / val loss | 100.22 / 100.09 |
| DDPM (T=300) | Avg loss (epoch 15) | 0.0454 |
| DCGAN | G / D loss | 3.41 / 0.32 |
| Latent diffusion MLP | MSE (epoch 150) | 0.224 |

Latent diffusion: I cite **0.224** to match the notebook write-up and README; `results/metrics/generative.json` rounds to **0.225**.
